rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone lacks energy and looks listless, rather than simply moving slowly or not caring.

example.english: They are lethargic all the time and cannot even get excited about their favourite things.
example.traditional: 佢成日無精打采，連平時最鍾意嘅嘢都提唔起勁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mou4 zing1 daa2 coi2 lin4 ping4 si4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5 dou1 tai4 m4 hei2 ging6

rows.note: Use this when the lethargy specifically shows in slow movements, actions, or pace.

example.english: They were lethargic getting dressed this morning, making the whole family wait.
example.traditional: 佢今朝慢吞吞咁着衫，搞到成家人等佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ziu1 maan6 tan1 tan1 gam3 zoek3 saam1 gaau2 dou3 sing4 gaa1 jan4 dang2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when the person is apathetic or unconcerned about something, rather than physically sluggish.

example.english: They are lethargic about their new job and do everything half-heartedly.
example.traditional: 佢對份新工好唔上心，叫佢做乜都得過且過。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 fan2 san1 gung1 hou2 m4 soeng5 sam1 giu3 keoi5 zou6 mat1 dou1 dak1 gwo3 ce2 gwo3
